scientific.integrity: The center follows from the published uniqueness of the center of area plus dihedral symmetry. The directional minimization and circular-segment evaluation are reconstructed explicitly; numerical code is used only to replay and stress-test the formulas, not to prove the continuum claim.
limitations: The theorem is specific to the Euclidean Reuleaux triangle.
It does not assert extremality for Winternitz measure among all bodies of constant width.
It does not compute higher regular Reuleaux odd-gons.
Historical originality retains residual risk from unindexed center-of-area literature.

title: Exact Winternitz measure of the Reuleaux triangle
